text:
I had an incredible experience at DOPA, truly one of the best wellness spaces I’ve ever visited. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels calm, welcoming, and beautifully designed, with a very serene, almost retreat-like vibe that instantly helps you switch off.

The food was outstanding, fresh, wholesome, and thoughtfully curated. We especially loved the immunity booster and the other wellness shots, which were both delicious and felt genuinely energising. It’s easy to see why so many people talk about their clean, nourishing menu and great coffee options too.

The wellness facilities were just as impressive. The sauna and steam rooms were perfectly maintained and incredibly relaxing, and the entire space felt very clean and well organised something a lot of visitors appreciate. We also tried the massages and they were fantastic, easily among the most relaxing treatments we’ve had. The therapists were skilled and the experience felt very personalised and unhurried.

What really stands out and something I’ve heard others mention as well is the overall energy of the place. It feels like a community space where you can slow down, recharge, and spend a few peaceful hours. The staff were warm and attentive, and everything from the facilities to the service felt premium yet comfortable.

We genuinely had the best time here and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Phuket who wants a mix of great food, wellness, and a truly relaxing experience.

Absolutely amazing experience! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel incredibly welcome, especially Katty, who was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and professional. The entire place is beautifully designed: stylish, cozy, and very relaxing.

The food was delicious, with a great selection and high quality dishes. The sauna area is outstanding, everything you could possibly need for a perfect spa and bath experience is there. The banya itself was excellent, and the pool is spacious enough to fully enjoy and relax.

One of the highlights for me was the ice plunge pools with different temperatures, such a refreshing and unique touch! You can really tell that every detail was carefully thought out.

This is the kind of place you genuinely want to come back to again and again. Highly recommended!

If you’re looking for a wellness spot to relax, recover, and hang out in Cherngtalay, I highly recommend DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club Phuket.
Great facilities, beautiful pool, and such a good atmosphere to spend the day. I especially loved the ice bath, steam room, and sauna — perfect for recovery and resetting both body and mind. They also have a nice café with good food, coffee, and soft drinks, so it’s easy to chill there for hours.
A really cool wellness community vibe overall… definitely one of my favorite places in Phuket to recharge and unwind.

I had a wonderful experience at this sauna in Thailand and was extremely satisfied overall. The location is beautiful, peaceful, and perfectly suited for relaxation. From the moment I arrived, I felt very comfortable and welcomed.

The service was outstanding — the staff were friendly, professional, and always attentive without being intrusive. Everything was well organized and very clean, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

I truly appreciated the calm atmosphere and the high level of care provided. This place is ideal for anyone looking to relax, unwind, and enjoy a high-quality sauna experience. I would definitely come back and highly recommend it to others visiting the area.

Recommend to visit 100%!!!😍

Magnificent! An amazing place. I especially loved the variety of baths and saunas, and the ice plunge pool! 🧊

The food is truly delicious. The syrniki are outstanding! 🤌🏼 Highly recommend trying the beef chorizo pizza as well.

I visited on a Monday during the day, so it wasn’t too busy — just perfect, which made the experience even better. I also used the fitness space on the second floor.

It’s great that you can work, relax, and meet interesting people all in one place!🥰

Dopa Sauna & Wellness Club is an amazing place.

Highly recommended I’ll definitely be back.

I came to DOPA on a day when my body felt tired and overloaded. I didn’t expect much, but I left feeling lighter. The food was honestly better than I thought — balanced, nourishing, and not heavy. The pizza crust was healthy and super crunchy, and I still finished it even though I was already full. That says a lot. The menu feels intentional, like it’s designed for recovery, not just for taste. The sauna and steam rooms were clean and well-managed. The herbal sauna session with the master was very hot but incredibly relaxing. The place itself looks modern and calm, not flashy. Staff were friendly and easygoing. Overall, it felt like a real wellness break, not just a club spa visit.

What stood out for me here was the food quality, especially the salads and fresh fruits. Everything tasted really fresh and clean, like you can tell the ingredients are well-selected. It didn’t feel like typical spa food that looks nice but tastes bland. The menu feels thoughtfully designed for wellness and recovery. You don’t leave feeling heavy or sleepy. I also like that the dishes feel nice serving and intentional, super professional 👏👏👏. It feels like the chef really understands nutrition and how food affects the body. You can sense that there’s knowledge and skill behind the menu. I left feeling light, satisfied, and not bloated. If you care about what you put into your body, this place makes sense.

The sky there is incredibly beautiful in the evening. I truly had an amazing time and would highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Phuket! 💖🌿✨

text: Hat. Cedar is better.

Pros: comfortable changing room, good food menu, and we liked the onsen and all the steam rooms. However, for a space labeled "sauna & wellness," it seemed like the cafe area with tables took up too much space and there weren't enough lounge chairs or relaxation areas. All the lounge chairs were occupied even in low season, and the large number of tables made it feel like a cafe, not a wellness space, which also happened to house the saunas and a pool. We'd have liked more comfort and a higher priority on the number of lounge chairs.

We hadn't booked and were visiting for the first time. At reception, we were told there were only tables and high chairs available, but we weren't shown inside or given any indication of the space before paying. It would have been nice to see the space and seating first before deciding whether to visit and pay.

Also, all such places should have freely accessible water coolers or pitchers, as it's crucial to stay hydrated after a sauna. They don't even provide one welcome bottle here and force you to buy water at a premium in the cafe.
